Method of Attack: Remote unauthenticated user can send instructions to the server to execute arbitrary code without requiring authorization or authentication
Man-in-the-middle (MITM) attack to read all keypresses in cleartext
Lack of password requirement allowing remote unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary code
Weak password enforcement and no rate limiting enabling brute force PIN attacks and arbitrary command execution
Impacted Systems: Android devices running Telepad, PC Keyboard, and Lazy Mouse apps
